questions.statement: When I arrived at the cinema, the movie ________ already ________.
questions.context: Identifying the structure of Past Perfect.

options.feedback: Correct! Past perfect structure: had + past participle.

questions.explanation:
El Pasado Perfecto se utiliza para hablar de una acción que ocurrió antes que otra acción en el pasado. Su estructura es el auxiliar "had" seguido del participio pasado.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: After I ________ my homework, I went out to play with my friends.

options.feedback: Incorrect. While possible, Past Perfect emphasizes the sequence better.
Correct! The action of finishing happened before going out.

questions.explanation:
Usamos el Pasado Perfecto para dejar claro cuál de las dos acciones pasadas ocurrió primero, especialmente después de palabras como "after".

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: By the time the bus arrived, we ________ for thirty minutes.

options.feedback: Correct! Waiting happened before the arrival.

questions.explanation:
La expresión "By the time" (Para cuando...) suele ir seguida de Pasado Simple, indicando que otra acción ya se había completado antes en Pasado Perfecto.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: I ________ very hungry because I ________ breakfast that morning.
questions.context: Contrast between Past Simple and Past Perfect.

options.feedback: Correct! The state of being hungry (Past Simple) was caused by not eating earlier (Past Perfect).
Incorrect. Tenses are in the wrong order of events.

questions.explanation:
El Pasado Perfecto se usa para explicar la "historia previa" de una situación en el pasado simple.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: She ________ just ________ the office when the phone rang.

options.feedback: Correct! "Had just + participle" means the action had recently finished before the next one.

questions.explanation:
La palabra "just" se puede usar con el Pasado Perfecto para enfatizar que la primera acción acababa de terminar justo antes de la segunda.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Before Bolívar entered Bogotá in 1819, the Royalist troops ________ the city.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Past Simple doesn't emphasize the previous action.
Correct! They left before his arrival.

questions.explanation:
Para narrar eventos históricos en secuencia, el Pasado Perfecto ayuda a establecer qué sucedió antes de un evento clave.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: In the sentence "When the police arrived, the thief had escaped," which action happened **first**?

options.feedback: Correct! The Past Perfect (had escaped) always indicates the earlier action.

options.text: Both happened at the same time.

questions.explanation:
La función gramatical del Pasado Perfecto es precisamente marcar la anterioridad de una acción respecto a otra acción pasada.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: "I wish I ________ more for the exam last week."

options.feedback: Incorrect. For past regrets, we use Past Perfect.
Correct! After "I wish", we use Past Perfect to express regret about a past event.

questions.explanation:
Utilizamos "I wish + Pasado Perfecto" para expresar arrepentimiento o el deseo de que algo en el pasado hubiera sido diferente.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: He ________ never ________ snow until he travelled to Europe last winter.

options.feedback: Correct! He hadn't seen it in all the time before that specific trip.

questions.explanation:
"Never... until" es una estructura común con el Pasado Perfecto para indicar que algo fue una experiencia totalmente nueva en ese momento del pasado.

---
questions.subject: ingles

options.text: By the time we got home, the rain had stopped.
I had already eaten when they invited me to dinner.
When I had seen him, I recognized him immediately.
options.feedback: Correct! Error found. Recognizing happens after/at the same time as seeing; it should be "When I saw him".

options.text: She was tired because she had worked all day.

questions.explanation:
No usamos el Pasado Perfecto para acciones que ocurren en secuencia inmediata o simultánea; en esos casos usamos el Pasado Simple.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Compare these two sentences:
1. When Maria called, I left the office.
2. When Maria called, I had left the office.

What is the difference in meaning?
questions.context: Evaluating the clarity of a story.

options.text: In both cases, I was in the office when she called.
In sentence 1, I left after the call; in sentence 2, I was already gone when she called.
options.feedback: Correct! Past Perfect changes the chronological order.

options.text: There is no difference in meaning.

questions.explanation:
El uso del Pasado Perfecto cambia radicalmente la cronología de una historia. El estudiante debe ser capaz de "ver" el orden de los eventos según el tiempo verbal.

---
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
"Carlos felt very nervous during his speech. He had spent weeks preparing his notes, but when he stood up in front of the audience, he realized he had left them at home."
What is the most likely result?
questions.context: Selecting the best conclusion for a narrative.

options.text: He had to improvise because he didn't have his notes.
options.feedback: Correct! Logical consequence in the past.

options.text: He will go home and bring the notes now.
He had already finished the speech when he arrived.
He spent weeks preparing for nothing.
options.feedback: Incorrect. While partly true, "had to improvise" is a better narrative conclusion.

questions.explanation: Para completar una narrativa compleja, el estudiante debe integrar el uso de tiempos pasados para mantener la coherencia de la historia y sus consecuencias.
